{{Quote|Zonama Sekot is nine thousand salt pans broad, that is, in Republic measure&hellip; eleven thousand kilometers. Its star system is a triple, in a hidden region of the Gardaji Rift, surrounded by great dust clouds. Two stars, a red giant and a white dwarf, orbit close to each other. Zonama Sekot circles the third star, a bright yellow sun, which orbits much farther out, several light-months distant. It is almost impossible to find if you don't know the way.|Charza Kwinn|<ref name="RP" />}}
This '''trinary star system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Gardaji sector/Legends|Gardaji sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was located in a hidden region at the far spinward of the [[Gardaji Rift/Legends|Gardaji Rift]] and was surrounded by great dust clouds. The system was noted by the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Charza Kwinn]] to be almost impossible to find if one didn't know its location. It consisted of three [[Star/Legends|stars]]—a [[Unidentified red giant (Gardaji Rift)|red giant]] and a [[Unidentified white dwarf|white dwarf]], [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] close to each other, and a small, bright [[Unidentified yellow dwarf|yellow dwarf]], located at a distance of several light-months from the other two stars. Materiel from the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] was pulled towards the white dwarf and then flung outward as ionized gas.

[[File:Zonama_Sekot_Tingel_Arm.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Zonama Sekot's position in the Tingel Arm]]
The system was noted to be devoid of life by several expeditions who charted the region of the Rift in which the system was located in approximately [[229 BBY/Legends|229 BBY]]. A seed of the extragalactic planet [[Yuuzhan'tar]] arrived in the system and became the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] at some point between then and [[89 BBY]], when it was colonized by a group of [[Ferroan]]s and [[Langhesi]]. The planet remained in the system for six [[Time/Legends|decades]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong|Far Outsiders]] attempted to settle the living planet and laid [[First Battle of Zonama Sekot|siege]] to it that continued for [[30 BBY/Legends|two years]]. [[29 BBY/Legends|A year later]] it was [[Second Battle of Zonama Sekot|attacked]] again, this time by a [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Republic Outland Regions Security Force]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] led by [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]]. However, Sekot unveiled its kilometers-high hyperdrive engines, recently built by the Langhesi, and fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="RP" />
